segments.text:
V. 34.
Take heed leſt at any time your hearts be overloaded with gluttony and drunkenneſs—And was there Need to warn the Apoſtles themſelves, againſt ſuch Sins as theſe? Then ſurely there is Need to warn even Strong Chriſtians, againſt the very groſſeſt Sins. Neither warn even Strong Chriſtians, againſt the very groſſeſt Sins. Neither are we wiſe, if we think ourſelves out of the Reach of any Sin: And ſo that day—Of Judgment or of Death come upon you, even you that are not of this World—unawares.
